title: manual BG checks keep replicating in Treatments
symptom: Manual BG checks added via xDrip and uploaded to NS keep being re-added to the Treatments list in AAPS/nsclient indefinitely, even after deleting duplicates, which are marked IsValid: false but still reappear.
cause: The thread suggests the problem is due to multiple apps uploading to NS without a sync protocol, leading to incompatible data and duplication in AAPS local database.
evidence_quote: problem is data from all apps are not 100% compatible, API v1 doesn't have sync protocol and finaly AAPS is using websockets and data comming through WS are even modified.
